title: Brain Note frontmatter
description: Canonical schema for the YAML frontmatter of every Brain Note (~/.claude/.kaizen/brain/Notes/*.md, ~/.claude/.kaizen/brain/People/*.md, etc.). Validated by skills/self-improving/brain/validator.py and skills/self-improving/application/_brain_tests.py. Replaces the prior duplicate at skills/self-improving/domain/schemas/note.schema.json (removed) — that copy had drifted from this one in required fields and enum values.

name.description: Human-readable title. Appears in the H1 and in cross-references. Strongly recommended — required for belief notes (enforced via the conditional below).

description.description: One-line summary used by Persona.md ## Top Beliefs and by the brain index. Strongly recommended — required for belief notes (enforced via the conditional below).

created.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the note was first written.

updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Auto-bumped on every write.

type.description: Epistemic / functional category. Union of brain's epistemic enum (world-fact, belief, observation, experience) and self-improving's operational types (feedback, audit, project, session, reference, user, system, persona, behaviour).

confidence.description: Best-estimate confidence 0.0-1.0. REQUIRED for type=belief (see conditional below). Distinguishes beliefs from world-facts.

sources_count.description: Number of evidence sources backing this note. Auto-incremented when evidence is appended; triggers brain promotion at >=2 for project-memory entries.

freshness.description: fresh=created/updated this week, stable=mature belief, hardened=top-belief candidate, stale=evolved/superseded, archived=retired.

source.description: Filesystem path to the Journal entry / project memory / commit / log that backs this note.

quote.description: Verbatim user quote when the evidence is a stated preference.

date.description: ISO date the evidence was captured.

promote.description: Project-memory only. Set to true to force brain promotion on the next kaizen-brain promote run.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata bag for skill-specific extensions.

then.description: Belief notes additionally require name, description, and confidence — they are the load-bearing fields for Persona.md ## Top Beliefs rendering.
